items.title: Disney Cuts More Than 100 Jobs In Theme Park Division
items.snippet: Skift Take: CEO Josh D’Amaro has said he is highly focused on reducing costs at the media giant. The Walt Disney Company has laid off between 100 and 200 employees in its theme park division, according to a person familiar with the matter.

items.title: How CIVILIAN Hotel Uses Canary to Eliminate Lobby Lines in a Small Space
items.snippet: CIVILIAN Hotel's 203-room NYC boutique property reduced front desk congestion by deploying Canary's kiosk, mobile check-in, digital authorizations, and guest messaging tools.

items.title: World Cup, March Madness, Roland-Garros: when the hotel takes its place in the locker room
items.snippet: As partners of federations and tournaments, the major hotel groups are turning their properties into the backdrop of the sporting event. Hilton and Marriott film the pre-match ritual there, Accor redefines a palace hotel in the colours of a Grand Slam, and Hyatt records a podcast by women tennis players.

items.title: From Airport to Rome’s City Center in 10 Minutes? ITA Airways and Archer Have a Plan
items.snippet: ITA Airways and Archer Aviation are exploring electric air taxi services connecting Italian airports with city centers, promising faster journeys aboard battery-powered aircraft, although certification and launch dates remain unresolved.

items.title: Stone Wood Hotels to enter wildlife resort segment with ‘Vanntalya’ brand; first property to open in Jawai next month
items.snippet: Goa-based mid-market hotel company Stone Wood Hotels has aggressive plans to expand into the boutique wildlife resort space with the new Vanntalya brand with at least 4 properties in key wilderness destinations in the next couple of years, says Shikhar Kumar, MD of the hotel company.

items.title: Hyatt signs four-hotel deal with Saraca across UP, Uttarakhand
items.snippet: Partnership brings two existing properties under Unscripted by Hyatt and adds two planned hotels near Jim Corbett National Park Hyatt Hotels Corporation has signed agreements with Saraca Hotels & Resorts to bring four hotels across Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand under its portfolio, expanding its presence in North India and introducing the Unscripted by Hyatt brand in India.

items.title: Himachal Secures 47.1% Revenue Share in Wildflower Hall Deal
items.snippet: The 35-year operating licence is expected to generate around INR 2,000 crore for the state, while ownership of the hotel and its underlying assets remains with the government. The Himachal Pradesh government has secured a 47.1% share of annual gross revenue through the auction of operating and management rights for Wildflower Hall, the luxury hotel property at Chharabra near Shimla.

items.title: Royal Caribbean’s Navigator of the Seas debuts in Asia
items.snippet: Royal Caribbean’s Navigator of the Seas has arrived in Singapore, marking its Asia debut and the beginning of a year-long sailing season from the city-state through October 2027.

items.title: Tarangire Sopa Lodge introduces night game drives
items.snippet: Tarangire Sopa Lodge in Tanzania has introduced night game drives at Tarangire National Park, offering guests a new way to experience the wilderness after sunset. The addition expands the lodge’s safari offerings, allowing visitors to explore the park’s nocturnal environment and observe wildlife behaviours that are rarely seen during daylight hours.

items.title: Black Rock Hotels and Resorts opens The Farm Stay by AamaGhati in Ranthambore
items.snippet: Black Rock Hotels and Resorts has announced the opening of The Farm Stay by AamaGhati, a 10-key boutique retreat in Village Sherpur, Ranthambore. Originally a private family residence owned by Abhishek Hissaria, the property has been converted into a hospitality retreat offering nature-focused stays, wildlife viewing, farm-led dining and local cultural experiences.
